title: host.update
description: Update existing hosts. The hostid property must be defined for each host, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated. Updating the host technical name also updates the visible name if not given separately.

inventory_mode.description: Host inventory population mode. Possible values: -1 - (default) disabled; 0 - manual; 1 - automatic.

ipmi_authtype.description: IPMI authentication algorithm. Possible values: -1 - (default) default; 0 - none; 1 - MD2; 2 - MD5; 4 - straight; 5 - OEM; 6 - RMCP+.

ipmi_privilege.description: IPMI privilege level. Possible values: 1 - callback; 2 - (default) user; 3 - operator; 4 - admin; 5 - OEM.

name.description: Visible name of the host. Default: host property value.

proxy_hostid.description: ID of the proxy that is used to monitor the host.

status.description: Status and function of the host. Possible values: 0 - (default) monitored host; 1 - unmonitored host.

tls_connect.description: Connections to host. Possible values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_accept.description: Connections from host. Possible bitmap values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 6 for PSK and certificate).

tls_psk_identity.description: (write-only) PSK identity; must be paired with only one PSK (across autoregistration, hosts, and proxies). Required if either tls_connect or tls_accept has PSK enabled. Do not include sensitive information in the PSK identity, as it is sent unencrypted over the network to inform the receiver which PSK to use.

tls_psk.description: (write-only) Pre-shared key (PSK); must be at least 32 hex digits. Required if either tls_connect or tls_accept has PSK enabled.

groups.description: Host groups to replace the current host groups the host belongs to. The host groups must have the groupid property defined. All host groups that are not listed in the request will be unlinked.

interfaces.description: Host interfaces to replace the current host interfaces. All interfaces that are not listed in the request will be removed.

interfaceid.description: (readonly) ID of the interface. Include to update an existing interface in place.

details.description: Additional object for interface. Required if interface type is SNMP.

version.description: SNMP interface version. Possible values: 1 - SNMPv1; 2 - SNMPv2c; 3 - SNMPv3.

bulk.description: Whether to use bulk SNMP requests. Possible values: 0 - don't use bulk requests; 1 - (default) use bulk requests.

community.description: SNMP community (required). Used only by SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 interfaces.

securityname.description: SNMPv3 security name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

securitylevel.description: SNMPv3 security level. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values: 0 - (default) noAuthNoPriv; 1 - authNoPriv; 2 - authPriv.

authpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 authentication passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

privpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 privacy passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

authprotocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values: 0 - (default) MD5; 1 - SHA1; 2 - SHA224; 3 - SHA256; 4 - SHA384; 5 - SHA512.

privprotocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values: 0 - (default) DES; 1 - AES128; 2 - AES192; 3 - AES256; 4 - AES192C; 5 - AES256C.

contextname.description: SNMPv3 context name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via IP.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via DNS.

main.description: Whether the interface is used as default on the host. Only one interface of some type can be set as default on a host. Possible values: 0 - not default; 1 - default.

port.description: Port number used by the interface. Can contain user macros.

type.description: Interface type. Possible values: 1 - agent; 2 - SNMP; 3 - IPMI; 4 - JMX.

useip.description: Whether the connection should be made via IP. Possible values: 0 - connect using host DNS name; 1 - connect using host IP address for this host interface.

tags.description: Host tags to replace the current host tags. All tags that are not listed in the request will be removed.

inventory.description: Host inventory properties. Keyed by host inventory field names (see host/object#host_inventory).

macros.description: User macros to replace the current user macros. All macros that are not listed in the request will be removed.

hostmacroid.description: (readonly) ID of the host macro. Include to update an existing macro in place.

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - (default) Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.

templates.description: Templates to replace the currently linked templates. All templates that are not listed in the request will be only unlinked. The templates must have the templateid property defined.

templates_clear.description: Templates to unlink and clear from the host. The templates must have the templateid property defined.
